maximum_set_size_rule: universe_size_minus_one; preserve complete membership; require a nonempty complement
multiple_testing: BH across 20 frozen custom sets per method, contrast and scenario, including ineligible/failed sets as unrejected; BY also exported; combined primary, periods and all other scenarios sensitivity; original MSigDB global BH unchanged
background_sensitivity: exclude 467 unevaluable primary promoters; preserve original voom weights and normalization exposures
residualization: descriptive regression on all primary ranked genes: ns(mean_logCPM, df=4) + ns(log10(feature_length_bp), df=4), optionally factor(arm); rank residuals without interpreting regression p-values; no claim of copy-number correction
sensitivity_multiplicity: report per-scenario BH and BY plus pooled sensitivity BH across all scenarios and contrasts within each method; primary family stays separate
unavailable_sensitivities: CpG content not available in the frozen gene covariates; sample-relevant copy-number correction remains unresolved; independent ChIP and own ATAC are later steps
interpretation: conditional RNA associations with measured baseline reference chromatin; serial passages of one established population per condition, not independent LOY-generation replication; no histone-change or enzyme-activity measurement
